messages:
morgan: Heads-up — ACME is close to signing a Dedicated contract covering EMEA + APAC. They want ~1.5M tokens/min sustained peak and 95th p99 latency <200ms for chat. APAC capacity is thin (ap-southeast1) and they're worried about cross-region bursting (egress/latency). Need a quick sizing + tradeoffs discussion for reserved pool vs smaller reserve + burst.
anya: Do we know model family and average prompt/response lengths? Tokens->GPU RPS translation matters a lot (70B vs 13B changes GPU counts).
raj: Quick back-of-envelope: if this is gpt-70B on A100 80GB quantized, rough throughput ~1.2k tokens/s per GPU (very workload dependent). 1.5M tokens/min -> 25k tokens/s. 25k / 1.2k ≈ 21 GPUs. With buffer/variance round to 25 GPUs reserved sustained.
sylvia: If we reserve 25 GPUs in ap-southeast1 vs reserving fewer and bursting to us-west2, egress charges + added latency could erase any savings. We should quantify egress cost and residency constraints.
raj: Very rough egress calc (for ballpark): use avg payload size assumptions. If avg response ~0.4KB/token: 25k tokens/s * 0.4KB = 10MB/s → ~36GB/hr → ~864GB/day. At $0.09/GB that's ~$78/day (~$2.4k/mo). If we used 1KB/token earlier, numbers blow up — so payload profiling is critical.
anya: Also note concurrency pattern: customer said short chat messages (avg ~50 tokens per request) but high QPS → tokens/request matters for batching efficiency. Need actual traces to pick efficient batch sizes; that affects tokens/s per GPU.
infra-bot: FYI: current ap-southeast1 H100/A100 pool utilization is ~85% with autoscale cap at 32 GPUs. We can provision reserved capacity but need a contractual commit to hold capacity for a customer spike.
sylvia: Options to present to ACME:
  1) Reserve full 25 GPUs in APAC: highest commit cost, zero cross-region egress, best latency and residency compliance.
  2) Reserve ~12 GPUs in APAC + allow burst to US with contractual egress cap and fallback model variants in-region: lower commit cost, potential egress and latency hits.
  3) On-prem / private APAC replica (higher upfront/ops cost) for strict residency.
raj: Scribble cost snippet (use for internal tradeoffs):
```
# monthly cost estimate (example)
Reserved A100 cost ≈ $2.95k - $3.2k per GPU / month (1yr term)
25 GPUs -> ~$73.8k - $80k / month
On-demand/burst unit cost +20-40%
Egress variable (see infra billing)
``` 
anya: Recommend immediate next steps:
  - get real payload traces (avg bytes/token, tokens/request distribution)
  - confirm model & perf bench (tokens/s per GPU) against target sequence lengths
  - confirm residency/legal constraints for APAC customers
  - run precise cost tradeoff script with our pricing and cloud egress tiers
morgan: I'll ask the account team for traces and residency notes. @sylvia can you run a perf bench on gpt-70B quant in ap-southeast1 (A100/H100) and share raw tokens/sec metrics? @finance please confirm current reserved GPU pricing to use in the calc.
sylvia: On it — I'll run the bench and attach results. ETA EOD tomorrow. Opening a networking ticket for cross-region egress policy/quotas (ticket #INF-1234).
finance: FYI our current negotiated 1yr reserved A100 price (Q1 2025) is $2.95k/GPU/month. Use that for scenarios unless procurement updates.
morgan: Great. I'll consolidate into a short one-pager with three commitment scenarios (full-reserve, hybrid-reserve+burst, private-replica) and include latency/egress/cost tradeoffs for ACME. :thumbsup:
